ActivStyle
distributes major medical, urological, and incontinence product manufacturers rather than fixing an exclusive list of consumer brands. For urological and catheter needs, they officially supply name brands like
Cure Medical
Coloplast
, and
Hollister
. For incontinence, pediatric, and other disposable supplies, they provide medical-grade items matching state Medicaid specifications.
ActivStyle
Distributed Manufacturers & Brand Types
Urological & Catheters:
Coloplast, Hollister, and Cure.
Incontinence & Bladder Control:
Medical-grade adult briefs, pull-ups, booster pads, and underpads.
Ostomy & Wound Care:
Standard major healthcare manufacturer items approved for insurance fulfillment.
